statistic: Within-brain SMA slope, log10 budget ~ log10 volume (all regions)
interpretation: Across regions within one brain: slope > 1 means larger regions use disproportionately more glucose per unit volume.

statistic: Within-brain OLS slope, log10 rCMRGlc ~ log10 volume (all regions)
interpretation: Equivalent to (budget slope - 1) under OLS; the within-brain analogue of Karbowski's exponent, but the predictor is regional volume, not species brain mass.

statistic: Coto 2026 cross-species SMA slope, brain MR ~ brain mass
interpretation: Across species: larger brains have lower mass-specific metabolic rate (hypometric).

statistic: Karbowski 2007 regional CMRgl exponents on brain mass (median; range)
interpretation: Across species: mass-specific regional CMRgl falls with brain mass to about the -0.15 power for nearly every structure.
